evidence.title: Custom Soundscapes for Focus, Relaxation & Sleep | myNoise ®

name: myNoise
summary: Adjustable soundscape generators for focus, relaxation and sleep, with per-frequency sliders and hearing calibration.
description: A library of sound generators — field-recorded nature sounds, ambient music and noise textures — grouped into Focus & Productivity, Meditation & Relaxation and Sleep Aid. Each generator is tuned with a bank of frequency sliders and an iEQ calibration that adapts the sound to your speakers and hearing. Free to use; donations unlock lifetime privileged access, and mobile apps unlock the full catalog with a one-time payment. Sounds are licensed for personal use only.
contains: sound generators grouped into Focus & Productivity, Meditation & Relaxation, Sleep Aid
each generator tuned with frequency sliders plus an iEQ calibration
library examples: Distant Thunder, Japanese Garden, Irish Coast, Medieval Library, Stormy Weather
iOS and Android apps: free soundscapes, one payment unlocks the full catalog
donations give lifetime privileged access to the website
